correctness.rationale: For every integer m>=1 and finite kappa>0 the trace-inverse formula follows by grounding one leader, completing a square, then applying Sherman--Morrison. Complete multipartite effective resistances follow from an explicit Laplacian eigenspace decomposition. Enumerating all two-leader automorphism orbits gives exact rational formulas. For m=1 the two competing differences to CC have positive numerators; for m=2,3 the four competing differences to BB have positive coefficients; for m>=4 the four competing differences to UB have strictly positive numerators and denominators, with BB/CC coefficients expressed as positive polynomials in u=m-4. The proof establishes strict optimality and unique orbit for every allowable m,kappa; 320 exact-rational resistance checks and 87 exact matrix inversions corroborate the derived formulas, not replace proof. The packaged verify.py reproduces these finite checks.

value.rationale: Noisy two-leader pinning minimizes stationary disagreement/control variance, so exact location is a natural optimization invariant. The result supplies an all-size and all-gain law with a surprising switch from two peripheral leaders to inclusion of a universal vertex at m=4, and resolves all competing orbits strictly without numerical optimization. It is a substantive complete classification on a natural near-balanced multipartite family, with a parameter-robust structural threshold; the exact boundary matters when designing leader placements without tuning gains.
